name: NEO Knowledge — KNOWINDEX
description: KNOWINDEX is the initial 1,000-share issuance identified by the issuer for NEO Knowledge: the partnership described by the project sponsor between Shelton Estate & Co. and the James A. Stanback Family Trust and its Free World Knowledge Foundation. The initiative connects the World Library with Moorish and Indigenous knowledge contributions, provenance, preservation, learning and documented knowledge-economy activity through NEO Crown Chain and NEO Nous OS. Specific share rights remain subject to governing documents. NEO measurements are independently defined; references to the UNDP/MBRF Global Knowledge Index are attributed external benchmarks.
